summary: Species-level bird trait tables are open (AVONET 11,009 species; BIRDBASE 78 traits for 11,589 species; EltonTraits foraging), and BirdTree is reachable, but none of the pages fetched confirms coded instinct traits such as nest type, song or migration for many allied species, so the behavioural variable is the gap.
next_step: Read the BIRDBASE xlsx header and the European life-history table to see which behavioural traits are coded; test whether nest type or migration status can be taken from them.
obstacles_confirmed: Many instincts lack standardized cross-species measurements.
Nest, song and display instincts are mostly uncoded in the tables found.
